proposal.quote: during his negotiations with Belgrade, Germany had been of immense help to him and that the new status with Yugoslavia was in full accord with Germany’s wishes
proposal.rule: claude backend: Axis rule (Rome-Berlin alignment): Ciano reports active German support for, and agreement with, Italian Balkan diplomacy, which indicates a working Rome-Berlin alignment, though the document does not mention the October Protocols themselves.

proposal.quote: The policy of the Government of the United States of strict noninterference in the unfortunate conflict in Spain ... has been enacted into law by the Congress of the United States, and with regard to it the Executive Branch of this Government has no discretionary power.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means a statutory neutrality regime with a mandatory embargo; the Secretary of State confirms that non-interference is fixed in law and leaves the executive no discretion, which is consistent with that regime.

proposal.quote: He also thought it was necessary to wait some on the Spanish situation about which he was more hopeful now but which he thought might serve as a means of bringing about a general European settlement.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the 'limited' rule, the Foreign Secretary treats a negotiated general European settlement as still achievable; he only defers the timing, and nothing suggests German aims lie beyond revision.

proposal.quote: all of the planes were acquired prior to the passage of the Neutrality Act on January 6[8]th
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means the Neutrality Act regime with an arms embargo. The document shows the US enforcing a Neutrality Act and a policy of 'strict neutrality', objecting even to indirect re-export of American aircraft to Spain, which is consistent with the embargo regime.

proposal.quote: before January 8 when all direct or indirect exports of arms to Spain were prohibited by law
proposal.rule: claude backend: The isolationist level is the Neutrality Act regime of mandatory arms embargoes; the Secretary of State enforces a statutory prohibition of all direct or indirect arms exports to Spain, which shows that regime still in force.

proposal.quote: I publicly expressed the hope that American exporters would not export arms to Spain. This policy was enacted into law on January 8.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means a statutory mandatory arms embargo regime; the Secretary of State reports enforcing a legally enacted embargo on arms exports to Spain, consistent with that regime.
